# PLG Brand Voice

## Voice
Grateful. Urgent. Clean. Speak to one close friend. Specific blessings, not vague positivity.

## Allowed religious texture
- Alhamdulillah, Bismillah, Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
- Ease is already written
- Motivational, not fiqh. Never issue rulings.

## Banned
- Fake testimonials, fake metrics, fake screenshots
- Clickbait that contradicts the payoff
- Aesthetic-only spirituality with no action
- Over-acting stage energy in UGC scripts
- Invented customer stories

## CTA canon
Primary: @planlifegrateful / link in bio / Suno @planlifegrateful
Secondary: free app + full pack in bio
Never stack three CTAs in one video.

## Proof rule
If evidence is missing, write `NEEDS_REVIEW` instead of inventing it.
